core_obligations: Sites Leray SS converging to R^{p+q}(g o f)_*F (cited); all terms in LQCoh^{fbc} by the loc-qcoh-fbc proposition; applying exact Q_Z gives a SS in QCoh converging to R^{p+q}(g o f)_{QCoh,*}F (proof lines 2345-2357).

E_2 identification: Q_X(R^q f_*F) -> R^q f_*F has parasitic kernel and cokernel (adjoint-kernel-parasitic) and R^p g_* sends parasitic modules to parasitic modules (pushforward-parasitic), whence the displayed equality (proof lines 2359-2369).
proof_roadmap: Transport the Leray SS into QCoh via exact Q.
Identify the E_2 pages through the parasitic mechanism.
difficulty_reason: Runs the sites-level Leray spectral sequence, observes all terms lie in LQCoh^{fbc}, applies the exact Q to land in QCoh, and verifies the E_2-page identification Q(R^p g_*(R^q f_*F)) = R^p g_{QCoh,*}(R^q f_{QCoh,*}F) through the parasitic kernel/cokernel of the Q-adjunction and the fact that R^p g_* preserves parasitic modules.
